mapper.insert: INSERT INTO videos (manuscript_id, video_order, title, play_url, duration_seconds, status, review_status, process_progress) VALUES (#{manuscriptId}, #{videoOrder}, #{title}, #{playUrl}, #{durationSeconds}, #{status}, #{reviewStatus}, #{processProgress})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM videos WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY upload_time DESC
SELECT * FROM videos WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY view_count DESC
SELECT * FROM videos WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY collect_count DESC
SELECT * FROM videos WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} ORDER BY upload_time DESC

SELECT v.*, m.title as manuscript_title, m.description as manuscript_description, m.cover_url as manuscript_cover_url, m.upload_time as manuscript_upload_time FROM videos v LEFT JOIN manuscripts m ON v.manuscript_id = m.id -- WHERE v.status = 1 暂时注释，方便测试显示所有视频 ORDER BY m.upload_time DESC, v.upload_time DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT v.*, m.title as manuscript_title, m.description as manuscript_description, m.cover_url as manuscript_cover_url, m.view_count as manuscript_view_count FROM videos v LEFT JOIN manuscripts m ON v.manuscript_id = m.id -- WHERE v.status = 1 暂时注释，方便测试显示所有视频 ORDER BY m.view_count DESC, v.view_count DESC LIMIT 10
mapper.update: UPDATE videos SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM videos ORDER BY upload_time DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT * FROM videos WHERE play_url IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT * FROM videos WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT * FROM videos WHERE manuscript_id = #{manuscriptId} ORDER BY video_order ASC
SELECT * FROM videos WHERE status = #{status} AND updated_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{minutes} MINUTE) ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE videos SET like_count = like_count + #{count} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE videos SET coin_count = coin_count + #{count} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE videos SET collect_count = collect_count + #{count} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE videos SET share_count = share_count + #{count} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE videos SET danmaku_count = danmaku_count + #{count} WHERE id = #{id}
